These '''InterGalactic Banking Clan's gun platforms''' constituted the space defense of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC's]] home planet of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]<ref name="SW:CW2" /> and other worlds.<ref name="Friends Like These">''[[Friends Like These]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Gunplatformacclamators.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A gun platform is pummeled by three ''Acclamator''s.]]

Their green hulls protected an array of hangars and gun-positions, and they were mostly crewed by droids. Squadrons of [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|''Nantex''-class starfighters]], modified for droid pilots, could be launched at a moment's notice, hitting any would-be attackers in massive swarms.<ref name="SW:CW2" />

==History==
These gun platforms did battle with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] invasion force during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], falling to concentrated fire from [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]].<ref name="SW:CW10" />

One platform was even blown up from the inside, when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] piloted his modified starfighter through an open hangarbay, trailing a swarm of [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] after him, which subsequently hit any objects close by.<ref name="SW:CW10" />

During the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], one gun platform was placed planet-side and became a [[Vlemoth Station|docking station]] at [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]].<ref name="Friends Like These" />

==Behind the scenes==
These Intergalactic Banking Clan Gun platforms share and aesthetic design with the heads of the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] droids that the banking clan used during the war. This includes the cylindrical shape and multiple red "eye" lights. However, their manufacturer has been left unconfirmed.
